title: End-to-End ML Pipeline Challenge
description: Scikit-learn kullanarak veri preprocessing, feature engineering, model selection, hyperparameter tuning ve evaluation adimlarini iceren komple bir ML pipeline kur. Gercek dunya senaryosuna yakin bir kredi risk tahmini problemi uzerinde calis.
objectives: Scikit-learn Pipeline ve ColumnTransformer kullanarak production-ready preprocessing olusturmak
Birden fazla modeli cross-validation ile kiyaslamak
Classification metriklerini (precision, recall, F1, ROC-AUC) dogru yorumlamak

    0.001 * df['yillik_gelir'].fillna(40000) / 1000 +
    np.random.normal(0, 0.3, n)
)
df['temerrut'] = (risk_score > np.percentile(risk_score, 75)).astype(int)
